title: 西游记 · 分级读物 (HSK 1-3)
source_material: 西游记 (Journey to the West) — opening episodes, retold

outline.title: 石头里的猴子
outline.summary: A stone on a high mountain splits open and a monkey is born. He can walk, run, and talk; the other monkeys make him their king. He starts to wonder what lies beyond the mountain.

outline.title: 猴王要学本领
outline.summary: The Monkey King leaves the mountain to find a teacher and learn real skills.
outline.recap: Sun Wukong, now monkey king, grows unhappy that he and the monkeys will age and die, so he leaves the mountain by boat to find a master and learn real skills; after many days he still hasn't found one.
